regions.name: Rio Negro
regions.quote: The majority of fish in the ornamental trade are collected in the rio Negro basin, Brazil.

regions.name: Amazon
regions.quote: Géry (1977) referred to these subspecies as 'forms' and chose to recognise two as distinct; C. strigata strigata with an essentially 'V'-shaped colour pattern found in Guyana, Suriname and parts of the Amazon, and C. strigata fasciata with a 'Y'-shaped colour pattern found throughout the Amazon, while also noting the existence of an intermediate form inhabiting the rios Negro and Orinoco.
